title: The Engines of American-Made Intelligence: NVIDIA and TSMC Celebrate First NVIDIA Blackwell Wafer Produced in the US
description: AI has ignited a new industrial revolution. NVIDIA and TSMC are working together to build the infrastructure that powers the world’s AI factories, right here in America.
